blurb: Guests can rent lakeview cabins with unlimited kayak access, rent boat slips for the season, and reserve seasonal camper spots near the water. The marina offers boat rentals, a gas dock, and a marina store. Activities include kayaking, paddleboarding, pontoon boat rentals, fishing, and lakeside dining.
extraNote: Minimum 2-night stay for cabin rentals; $75 cleaning fee per booking · Boat safety rules apply including life jackets, slow-no-wake zones, and boat registration · Best time June through August; seasonal boat slips and campsites available
